name: Shark, Giant
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13, Stealth 10. Modifiers STR +6, DEX +0, CON +5, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −3. Natural armor. Keensense 60 ft. No languages.
appearance: A heavy gray shark with a pale belly, a broad head and an open, tooth-lined jaw.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos, licensed 2025 Spanish translation of Kobold Press Monster Vault, printed p. 358–359, Tiburón, Gigante. XP is from the challenge table on p. 17. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The shark has advantage on melee attacks against creatures below their hit point maximum.
Blood Sense. By scent, the shark can pinpoint creatures below their hit point maximum within 120 ft. and discern their general direction up to 1 mile away.
Electrical Sensitivity. When the shark takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or become incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Water Breathing. The shark breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Swift Hunter. Move up to half the shark’s speed toward a hostile creature it can see. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Snake, Constrictor
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 10, Stealth 12. Modifiers STR +2, DEX +2, CON +1, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −4. Keensense 10 ft. No languages.
appearance: A thick-bodied snake with dark brown blotches across its tan coils and a low, broad head.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos, licensed 2025 Spanish translation of Kobold Press Monster Vault, printed p. 355, Serpiente, constrictora. XP is from the challenge table on p. 17. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller target hit this way becomes grappled, escape DC 12. The target is restrained until the grapple ends. The snake cannot use Constrict against another target while it holds this grapple.
sections.Bonus actions: Crush. One creature grappled by the snake must pass a DC 12 Strength save or take 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and begin suffocating until the grapple ends.

sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. The target must also succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or take 5 (2d4) poison damage.
